old_pipeline_legacy.title: Legacy Pipeline (Before Modifications)
old_pipeline_legacy.summary: Siloed components, volatile sessions, 2D flat computer vision, aggressive non-contextual audio feedback, camera-only nutrition tracking, and disconnected static achievements.

stages.name: Authentication & Session Management
stages.input: User credentials or social login trigger
steps: Manual authentication request via Supabase/ICP
Session stored insecurely or ephemerally without persistent session sync
Inconsistent user identification across app (separate use of email, principal ID, local ID)
stages.output: Fragile session that is lost on app refresh or close
key_issues: Session drops on app close or browser refresh
User forced to re-login every session
Sign-out button hanging or unresponsive in multiple views
Slow authentication handshake without background caching

stages.name: Camera & 2D Pose Detection
steps: Camera initialized at standard low resolution (640x480) with default frame rates
Lightweight MediaPipe BlazePose model executed without hardware capability detection
Raw 2D landmark coordinates extracted directly from flat screen pixels (X, Y)
Direct mathematical angle calculations between 2D screen points
stages.output: Flat screen angles vulnerable to camera tilt and perspective distortion
key_issues: No kinematic filtering causing severe limb jitter and rubber-banding
2D angles produce inaccurate rep counts if user is angled 45 degrees to the camera
Low pixel density drops joint detection in low-light environments

stages.name: Form Correction & Real-Time Feedback
steps: Linear conditional check (If angle < threshold -> Wrong, else Right)
Immediate voice synthesizer trigger on every single deviation frame
No awareness of movement phases (eccentric descent vs concentric ascent)
key_issues: Acts like an overwhelming biomechanical exam shouting cues every second
Multiple conflicting cues shouted simultaneously (e.g., knees wrong + back wrong)
No tolerance filtering between minor micro-deviations and dangerous faults
No verification step to check if the user actually corrected the fault

stages.name: Food Scanner & Nutrition Tracking
steps: User captures photo with device camera
Image sent to multimodal vision model
Basic macro estimation returned
key_issues: Zero manual food entry option if user forgets to take a photo
No ability to specify gram serving weights accurately
Model calls with strict JSON mode returned empty/zero values on lightweight models
Zero offline fallback; network drop prevents logging

stages.name: Achievements & User Progression
steps: 3,000-line monolithic deprecated accordion component rendered
Hardcoded empty user data passed (0 workouts, 0 streaks)
Requires user to manually click 'Start Achievement' button for each individual exercise
key_issues: No auto-sync with actual workout history recorded in exercises table
No Athlete Level, XP, or Rank system
Requires manual button click to track exercises already performed
No real-time event listener to update when workouts finish

new_pipeline_current.title: Current Production Pipeline (After Complete Upgrades)
new_pipeline_current.summary: Persistent single sign-on, HD 3D metric world tracking with bone rigidity filters, 5-layer autonomous coaching loop, dual vision + manual offline food estimation, auto-reconciling cloud database achievements with Athlete XP Ranks, and a unified reactive event bus.

stages.name: Persistent Identity & Session Management
stages.input: User Login (Email, Google OAuth, or ICP Internet Identity)
steps: Automatic token verification and persistent localAccountStorage initialization
Session restored instantaneously (0ms) upon opening app, matching Facebook session model
Unified identity resolver ('resolveDbUserId') maps all auth providers to clean Supabase UUIDs
Responsive, reliable Sign-Out handler with local cache clearing
stages.output: Permanent authenticated session and universal resolved user ID across all tables
key_advantages: Zero unwanted re-logins on app restart
Seamless offline mode with instant local caching

stages.name: HD Camera & 3D Kinematic Pose Tracking
steps: Adaptive hardware detection switches to MediaPipe Heavy model on 4+ core systems
Kinematic Bone-Rigidity Filter clamps 8 primary limb segments to running EMA baseline (+/- 25%)
Elimination of jitter and elastic rubber-banding during rapid movements
Metric 3D World Coordinates ('poseWorldLandmarks') stored in physical meters
True 3D perspective-invariant angle calculation independent of phone camera angle
stages.output: Biomechanically precise 3D joints and perspective-invariant angles
key_advantages: HD clarity and high confidence tracking (0.65 detection / 0.70 tracking)
Rock-solid bone lengths with zero jitter
Perspective-free angles accurate from 0 to 90 degree camera angles

stages.name: 5-Layer AI Coaching Architecture
stages.input: Continuous 3D landmark streams & calculated metric joint angles
steps: Layer 1 (Phase Detector): Identifies Eccentric descent, Isometric pause, Concentric ascent, Lockout
Layer 2 (Tolerance Engine): Evaluates deviation severity (Micro vs Moderate vs Critical injury-risk)
Layer 3 (Micro-Cue Engine): Selects exactly ONE clear actionable cue (e.g., 'Chest proud', 'Knees outward')
Layer 4 (Verification Loop): Checks next repetition; rewards correction with positive praise and stays silent when form is good
Layer 5 (Pattern Learner): Analyzes fatigue curves across sets and warns before injury breakdown
stages.output: Natural personal coach experience (constructive, timely, non-intrusive) + post-workout biomechanical report
key_advantages: Feels like an elite human coach standing by your side
No conflicting cues; single priority cue per rep

stages.name: Dual AI Vision & Smart Manual Nutrition Engine
stages.input: Camera photo snapshot OR Manual food name + gram weight
steps: Mode A (Visual): Gemini Multimodal Vision analysis for plate photo scans
Mode B (Manual): Serving weight presets (30g, 50g, 100g, 150g, 200g, 300g) + custom gram slider
Gemini Dietitian Prompt optimized for plain text output across all model variants
4-Layer Parsing Stack (Direct JSON -> Regex extraction -> Markdown stripping -> Normalizer)
36-Item Local USDA Nutritional Database Fallback guarantees zero 0s even when completely offline
Instant save to localAccountStorage + background sync to Supabase 'food_logs'
stages.output: Accurate calorie and macro breakdowns (Protein, Carbs, Fats, Sugar) logged immediately
key_advantages: Complete flexibility: scan photo or log manually in seconds

stages.name: Gamified Auto-Reconciling Cloud Progression Engine
stages.input: Completed workout sessions, cumulative rep logs, streaks, and calorie burns
steps: Auto-Reconciliation Service: queries 'exercises' historical logs + 'user_stats' + 'achievements'
Self-Healing: Automatically computes true cumulative reps/time per exercise and awards missing milestones to cloud DB
Multi-Level Calibrated Catalog: 18 exercises across 5 progressive tiers (Bronze -> Silver -> Gold -> Platinum -> Diamond)
Athlete Rank System: 5 Athlete Tiers based on total XP (Rookie Mover -> Apex Legend)
Event Bus Broadcast ('ACHIEVEMENTS_UPDATED_EVENT'): Real-time UI refresh across tabs with 0ms page reload
Interactive Bento Dashboard: Category filters, search, glowing tier badges, and Detail Modal with 'Train Now' deep linking
stages.output: Live gamified athlete progression profile synchronized across all devices
key_advantages: Zero manual tracking required; workouts instantly translate to badges
Engaging athlete tier ranks with visual rewards and direct workout launching
